definition: to express your choice for a candidate
description: A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.

en.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?

de.answer: Sie reckt nach der Stimmabgabe die Faust in die Luft.
